completionPolicy.requires: All visible required core/branch choices and required text fields

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.intro
elements.html:
Judge a suggestion against practical constraints and justify a tool choice.

You decide what a useful result means. A fluent suggestion can still miss your time, budget, or audience. Write down the constraints, compare the suggestion with them, and change or reject it. You can do this with a person, a checklist, or an AI tool. Choosing not to use AI is a valid outcome; the goal is a decision you can explain.

Practice scenario

Fictional club brief: six students have 10 minutes, no spending money and no phones. A draft suggests a paid online tournament lasting 45 minutes.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.repair
elements.title: Which revision fits all three constraints?

choices.text: Keep the tournament but call it quick.
Run a 10-minute paper word game using scrap paper.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.repair.feedback.paid
elements.html: A new label does not change the cost, phones, or duration.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.repair.feedback.paper
elements.html: This fits time, cost, and device constraints; check that everyone can participate.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.repair.feedback.buy
elements.html: That breaks the zero-spending constraint.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.tool
elements.title: What is a defensible way to choose your tool?

choices.text: Use AI because newer tools are always better.
Use a checklist or ask the club; use AI only if it adds something worth checking.
Let the tool choose without reviewing it.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.tool.feedback.always
elements.html: Novelty is not evidence of usefulness.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.tool.feedback.fit
elements.html: Either a non-AI or AI-supported route can work when you explain the fit.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.tool.feedback.obey
elements.html: You remain responsible for whether the plan works.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.constraint_check
elements.title: What should guide a revised plan?

choices.text: The actual time, cost and device limits.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.constraint_check.feedback.label
elements.html: Excitement does not resolve the constraint mismatch.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.constraint_check.feedback.limits
elements.html: Use the stated limits to evaluate the plan.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.transfer
elements.title: Write a short replacement plan. Explain how it meets all three constraints: 10 minutes, no spending money, and no phones. Choose AI, a checklist, a person, or no tool and explain why that choice fits. Identify a role to consult, such as the club organizer, rather than a real person’s name.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l01.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Plan fits 10 minutes, no money, and no phones.
  • Justifies why AI, a checklist, a person, or no tool fits the task.
  • Identifies an inclusion check and a role to consult without personal information.

A proposed activity is not proven successful until tried with its actual participants.
